第十一章 水榭藏阴诡奸计当场破（第1页）
后园深处花木茂密，连片海棠树层层叠叠，粉白花瓣被晚风拂落，铺满曲折的青石小径。越往水榭方向走，周遭人声越发稀疏，前院的丝竹谈笑被林木阻隔，只剩下风吹枝叶的簌簌响动。
沈清鸢步履平缓，看似闲散观赏沿途花木，眼角余光却始终留意身后。四名伪装成侯府杂役的汉子跟得越发近了，彼此用眼神暗中示意，悄然加快脚步，慢慢把她圈往临水的八角凉亭。
凉亭依水而建，四周被浓密花枝围拢，平日里极少有宾客闲逛至此，正是萧景煜精心挑选的行凶之地。领头汉子从袖口摸出一小包灰白色药粉，藏在掌心，假意上前引路：“姑娘，亭中备好茶水，不妨坐下歇歇脚。”
就在那人伸手要往茶盏里掺药的刹那，密林里骤然蹿出数名黑衣暗卫，刀鞘相撞的脆响打破园内静谧。四名汉子大惊失色，慌忙想要藏起药粉四散逃窜，可暗卫早把四周去路封死，不过片刻功夫，四人尽数被按倒在地，掌心的迷药、身上东宫专属的暗记腰牌全都被搜了出来。
沈清鸢立在廊下，冷眼望着被捆缚的四人，神色没有半分波澜。从踏入侯府开始，她便笃定萧景煜一定会在此动手，如今人赃并获，便是扳倒对方最实在的凭据。
前厅之内，萧景煜正陪着一众王公权贵闲谈，表面谈笑风生，心底却在暗暗等候后园传来得手的消息。忽然有侯府管事神色慌张快步入内，凑在平宁侯耳边低声禀报几句。平宁侯脸色骤变，当即起身朝着水榭方向赶去，满席宾客察觉异样，纷纷好奇尾随。
一行人赶到后园水榭，恰好撞见被绳索捆缚的四名刺客，桌上还摆着没来得及动手的茶水与迷药。萧景煜脸色瞬间惨白，强装镇定上前呵斥：“尔等刁奴，竟敢在侯府行凶！”
“太子殿下不必费心演戏。”萧聿辞缓步从花丛中走出，玄色衣袍沾了零星落瓣，语气清冷，“人犯身上带着东宫腰牌，药粉物证俱在，众目睽睽之下，殿下还要狡辩吗？”
周遭世家小姐、王公大臣纷纷议论，一道道探究又鄙夷的目光尽数落在萧景煜身上。谁都看得明白，费尽心机埋伏人手、在赏花宴下药，目标正是一旁安然立着的沈清鸢。
萧景煜百口莫辩，指尖死死攥紧，万万没想到万全的谋划，竟被摄政王提前布下的暗卫全盘截破。
消息不过半个时辰便传回丞相府凝香院。原本坐等喜讯的柳氏听见丫鬟来报，身子一软瘫坐在椅子上，脸上血色尽失。沈轻柔在一旁吓得浑身发抖，母女二人费尽心思布下的大局，转瞬便化作泡影，反倒留下一桩扳倒她们的把柄。
沈清鸢望着慌乱难堪的萧景煜，眼底掠过淡淡冷意。前世她在此地身败名裂，蹉跎一生，今生风水轮转，作恶之人，自该吞下自己种下的恶果。

Chapter 11 The treacherous plot hidden in the waterside pavilion was revealed on the spot (page 1)
Deep in the back garden, there are dense flowers and trees, with cascading crabapple trees, their pink and white petals blown off by the evening breeze, covering the winding bluestone paths. As we walked towards the waterside pavilion, the sounds of people around us became sparse. The chatter and laughter of silk and bamboo in the front yard were blocked by the trees, leaving only the rustling of the branches and leaves in the wind.
Shen Qingyuan walked slowly, seemingly casually admiring the flowers and trees along the way, but he was always looking behind him from the corner of his eye. Four men disguised as servants in the Hou Mansion followed her closer and closer. They secretly signaled to each other with their eyes, quietly quickened their pace, and slowly circled her towards the octagonal pavilion by the water.
The pavilion was built by the water and surrounded by thick flowers and branches. Very few guests would wander here on weekdays. It was the place carefully chosen by Xiao Jingyu to commit the crime. The leading man took out a small packet of gray-white medicinal powder from his sleeve, hid it in the palm of his hand, and pretended to lead the way: "Girl, tea is ready in the pavilion. You might as well sit down and have a rest."
The moment the man stretched out his hand to add medicine to the tea cup, several black-clothed guards suddenly jumped out of the dense forest, and the crisp sound of their scabbards colliding broke the silence in the garden. The four men were frightened, and hurriedly tried to hide the powder and flee, but the secret guards had already blocked the surrounding routes. Within a moment, all four men were pushed to the ground, and the drugs in their palms and the Dong Palace's exclusive secret badges were all searched out.
Shen Qingyuan stood in the corridor, looking coldly at the four people who were tied up, with an unperturbed look on his face. From the moment she stepped into the Hou Mansion, she was sure that Xiao Jingyu would definitely take action here. Now that both people and stolen goods were obtained, this was the most solid evidence to overthrow the opponent.
In the front hall, Xiao Jingyu was chatting with a group of princes and dignitaries, chatting and laughing on the surface, but secretly waiting for news of success from the back garden. Suddenly, a steward of the Marquis Mansion quickly walked in with a panicked look and whispered a few words in Marquis Pingning's ear. Marquis Pingning's expression changed suddenly, and he immediately stood up and rushed towards the water pavilion. The guests at the table noticed something strange and followed him out of curiosity.
The group of people rushed to the waterside pavilion in the back garden and happened to encounter four assassins tied up with ropes. There were also tea and poison on the table that they had not had time to take action on. Xiao Jingyu's face instantly turned pale, he pretended to be calm and stepped forward to scold: "How dare you, these unscrupulous slaves, commit murder in the Marquis' Mansion!"
"Your Highness, you don't have to worry about acting." Xiao Yuci walked out of the flowers slowly, his black robe stained with scattered petals, and said in a cold tone, "The prisoner is wearing the East Palace waistband, and the powder and evidence are all there. In front of everyone, do you still want to quibble?"
The young ladies from aristocratic families, princes and ministers all around were talking about it, and all their probing and disdainful glances fell on Xiao Jingyu. Everyone could see clearly that the target of all the efforts to ambush people and drugged the flower viewing banquet was Shen Qingyuan, who was standing safely beside him.
Xiao Jingyu was speechless and clenched his fingertips tightly. He never expected that his perfect plan would be completely intercepted by the secret guards deployed by the regent in advance.
The news was sent back to the Ningxiang Courtyard of the Prime Minister's Mansion in less than half an hour. Mrs. Liu, who had been waiting for the good news, heard the maid coming to report, and she slumped down on the chair, with all the color on her face gone. Shen Qingrou was trembling with fear at the side. The overall situation that the mother and daughter had worked so hard to set up came to naught in an instant, leaving only a handle to bring them down.
Shen Qingyuan looked at the flustered and embarrassed Xiao Jingyu, with a faint coldness in his eyes. In her previous life, she was ruined here and her whole life was wasted. In this life, the situation is changing, and those who do evil should swallow the evil consequences they have sown.
